user.title: Thermostat Proxy
user.description: Wrap a thermostat and expose a virtual one with selectable sensors.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Thermostat Proxy
reconfigure.description: Update the name or physical thermostat, then manage sensors.

sensors.title: Temperature sensors
sensors.description: Add at least one sensor. Each one becomes a preset mode.

remove_sensor.title: Remove a sensor
remove_sensor.description: Select a sensor to remove from this thermostat.

replace_sensor_details.title: Replace a sensor
replace_sensor_details.description: Update the name and temperature entity for this sensor.

finalize.title: Defaults
finalize.description: Optionally rename the physical thermostat preset and decide which sensor (including the last active one) should be active on startup.

data_description.cooldown_period: Minimum wait time between setpoint adjustments sent to the physical thermostat to prevent short-cycling. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.default_sensor: Sensor preset to activate on startup or when the integration reloads. Choose a specific sensor or 'Last active sensor'.
data_description.default_target_humidity: Initial target relative humidity percentage slider on the proxy entity (30% - 99%).
data_description.max_humidity_overcool: Maximum degrees the system may cool below target temperature to dehumidify the room when high humidity is detected. Set to 0 to disable (default 2.0°).
data_description.max_sync_offset: Maximum degrees of offset allowed between the active sensor and physical setpoint. Protects against wild offsets if a sensor is faulty. Set to 0 to disable (default 10.0°).
data_description.max_temp: Highest allowable target temperature (safety ceiling). Any target above this is clamped. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.min_dual_temp_spread: Minimum degree separation between heat and cool setpoints sent to the physical thermostat in Heat/Cool mode (e.g. 5.0°F for ecobee). Prevents hardware firmware setpoint clamping. Set to 0 for automatic.
data_description.min_temp: Lowest allowable target temperature (safety floor). Any target below this is clamped. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.overdrive_offset: Extra degree offset applied to force the physical thermostat to run when the remote sensor is not satisfied but the thermostat is idle. Set to 0 to disable (default 1.0°).
data_description.physical_sensor_name: Preset name for the physical thermostat's internal temperature sensor (defaults to 'Physical Entity').
data_description.physical_target_change_behavior: How the proxy responds when setpoints are changed directly on the physical thermostat hardware (e.g., turning the physical dial).
data_description.sensor_change_threshold: Minimum temperature change required at the active sensor before updating the physical thermostat. Filters out noise and frequent micro-adjustments. Set to 0 to disable.
